newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom to offer new rates for residential users.
newsitem.headline: Telekom to offer new rates for residential users.

text.p: German phone giant Deutsche Telekom AG said on Thursday it would offer two new phone rates for residential customers in January that could be particularly attractive for Internet surfers.

Under the CityWeekend tariff customers will pay five marks up front and will then be able to place local calls on weekends and holidays between 5 a.m. and 9 p.m. at a charge of 1.80 marks an hour instead of 2.88 marks.

With the CityPlus tariff customers can buy 400 calling units in advance for 23.99 marks, or 6 pfennigs a unit instead of 12 pfennigs. One calling unit is 90 seconds. This tariff is also valid from 5 a.m. until 9 p.m. on weekends and holidays.
There is a one-time installation charge of nine marks for each tariff. The new tariffs take effect on January 5, 1997.
